title: Bowletta! (Pre-Final Battle) 🔥💜
description: A twisted fusion of evil returns…
body:
A twisted fusion of evil returns…


From Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga (3DS remake), **Bowletta** arrives in Minecraft in her form before the final soul battle with Cackletta — the corrupted fusion of Bowser’s body and Cackletta’s power. 👑💀


This **resource pack** brings Bowletta to life with:


🧬 A **fully custom model and texture** based on the 3DS remake by AlphaDream


🔊 **Sound effects** sourced from YoshyMaker’s Bowser model in the Mario Mania mod


🎵 At the very start of combat, the **official final Bowletta battle theme** from the remake plays


👁️ Accurate visual details that capture her monstrous, regal, and unsettling appearance before Cackletta’s soul emerges


Enter the throne room… and face the terrifying queen of the Beanbean Kingdom. 👑🔥


**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by YoshiMaker of Larry Koopa,
which replaces him with Bowletta.

[https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M](https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M)


-Custom texture pack (x16)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Superstarsaga

-You need the [https://modrinth.com/mod/mario-mania/version/2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/mario-mania/version/2.0)

-Also [https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/ApKEGN4z)

-And also [https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/playeranimator/version/1.0.2+1.19.4-forge)
